pages.text: Fill a $(item)Malting Tub$() with water and barley (or wheat). The grain steeps, the water drains, and it sprouts into $(item)green malt$().

Roast green malt in the $(item)Kiln$(): Light gives $(item)pale malt$(), Medium $(item)amber$(), Dark $(item)black$(). The kiln burns its own fuel. It also dries hops (Light) and roasts coffee and agave (Medium).

pages.name: Grain to Grist
pages.text: Steep and sprout in the Malting Tub, roast in the Kiln, grind on the Millstone.
